doctrine.shared_source: single canonical repository; no OS-specific code fork

transitional_boundaries.hermes_principal: hermes-operator remains a shared logical id during phase 1
transitional_boundaries.workers: worker identity namespace is not yet instance-separated
transitional_boundaries.claim: DIE-WINDOWS and DIE-LINUX are cognitively isolated company instances in phase 1; full operational active-active federation is NOT claimed

guardrails: Windows principal ids must never be rebound to Linux external accounts.
Linux principal ids must never authenticate against Windows MCP endpoints.
No shared browser profile, OAuth secret, MCP token, or mutable state directory across instances.
Linux improvements flow back to Windows only through reviewed shared-canon version upgrades.
No cross-instance decision routing unless a future governed federation contract explicitly authorizes it.
